name: Gameplay prototypes and a fuller horizontal slice
body: Dean (2026-11-16): the companion does little beyond the Boost and one platform type, and the Crimson and Thorn gameplay loop may not be fun by itself. Prototype a menu of gameplay ideas as small isolated rooms (each reachable from a Prototypes menu button), give the companion a real command model, then grow streets, rooftops and streets-later into a fuller horizontal slice to judge how fun a level is to work through. Every puzzle stays solvable alone. Feel is the point, so distances and timings are named constants listed in docs/gameplay-prototypes.md. Look and lighting (night time) and the photo collectible belong to the sibling thread.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's feedback that the Crimson and Thorn loop needs prototyping: more companion mechanics, more variety, a fuller level slice.

plan: 1. Ideas doc. 2. Companion command model. 3. Switch, plate and door system. 4. Prototype rooms. 5. Expand the level chain. 6. Playtest checklist.
acceptance_criteria: docs/gameplay-prototypes.md lists 8-12 ideas with companion use, solo solution, cost and fun hypothesis
4-6 prototype rooms play from the Prototypes menu
The streets, rooftops and streets-later are longer, with a rhythm of traversal, puzzle, hazard, companion beat, collectible and rest
docs/playtest-checklist.md tells Dean what to try and note
